name: FUN_WF_HISTORY_LINES
description: FUN_WF_HISTORY_LINES contains the approval and rejection history of each submission that passes through the  Approval Workflow process. This table is for capturing the complete history and submission details.

columns.name: HISTORY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for every record created under approval cycle.

columns.name: HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier that correlates the table FUN_WF_HISTORY with the table FUN_WF_HISTORY_LINES.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action performed on the transaction.Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_FUN_APPROVAL_ACTION.

columns.name: ACTED_BY
columns.description: User who performed the action on the transaction.

columns.name: ACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when an assignee performed an action on a particular workflow task.

columns.name: TASK_NUMBER
columns.description: Task number of the notification assignment.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: Task ID of the notification assignment.

columns.name: HISTORY_HASHCODE
columns.description: Stores the hash code keys for comments, attachments, or history records. Hash code keys are 20 characters long. The application can store a maximum of 11 hash codes separated by comma. As a result, the length limit for the column is 229 characters, including commas.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_NAME
columns.description: Participant Name where the workflow rule is defined.

columns.name: RULE_NAME
columns.description: Workflow rule used for assigning the workflow task to the user.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
